item.title: Official The Elder Scrolls 6 Announcement Imminent, Report Says
item.description: The Elder Scrolls fans know that Bethesda is hard at work on the next highly anticipated roleplaying game entry, The Elder Scrolls 6 , but that's about it. The lack of concrete information is wild when you consider that the sequel to The Elder Scrolls 5: Skyrim was announced a whopping eight years ago. Fans' patience may finally be about to pay off.

item.title: Ubisoft Issues Official Update on Fate of Future Assassin's Creed Remakes
item.description: Ubisoft's latest Assassin's Creed game was a blast from the past. Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced is a remake of the 2013 pirate adventure. As remakes become more and more common in the industry, fans have naturally wondered if more Assassin's Creed remakes are in the pipeline. In 2024, CEO Yves Guillemot hinted at such , saying, "Players can be excited about some remakes, which will allow us to revisit some of the games we've created in the past and modernize them."

item.title: Steam Makes 96% Positive Puzzle Game Completely Free
item.description: Puzzle games have a special way of making you feel clever. Whether you’re solving elaborate environmental challenges in Portal 2 , untangling mind-bending mysteries in The Witness , or figuring out the next move in Baba Is You , few things are as satisfying as finally cracking a puzzle that’s had you stumped.

item.title: Patrick Stewart's Greatest Captain Picard Quote Is Still a Defining Star Trek Moment
item.description: Every Star Trek fan has an opinion on the franchise's greatest captain. Some prefer the swagger of James T. Kirk (William Shatner). Others admire Benjamin Sisko (Avery Brooks) for his conviction, or Kathryn Janeway (Kate Mulgrew) for her resilience. But ultimately, Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) usually wins those debates because he embodied the very best of Starfleet: intelligence, diplomacy, curiosity, and compassion.

item.title: Square Enix should never make a Final Fantasy game without turn-based combat again
item.description: I had few expectations going into Final Fantasy Resonance , the premium game based on Square Enix's mobile gacha Brave Exvius . Those expectations lowered in the first 10 hours, thanks to its frankly atrocious writing. But after clearing most of the story and approaching the endgame, I find I've changed stances entirely. Resonance is everything Final Fantasy has struggled to achieve over the better part of two decades — confident, innovative, engaging, and, most importantly, completely and unashamedly itself. It's the blueprint Square Enix needs to follow for the series' future.

item.title: Star Trek and X-Men Icon Patrick Stewart Dies at 86
item.description: Patrick Stewart, the actor best known for his commanding roles as Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation and Professor Charles Xavier in the X-Men film franchise, has died, according to a statement from his family. Stewart was 86.

item.title: 'Whence the Weeping' quest walkthrough in Phantom Blade Zero
item.description: "Whence the Weeping" is a side quest in Phantom Blade Zero that you start very early in the game. Unlike the "A Healer's Mercy" and "Flesh Lily" secondary missions, which have more straightforward objectives, this quest asks you to simply "find the source of the weeping." Besides, it takes longer to finish than one would assume based on when this side quest starts.

item.title: New James Bond Officially Joins The 007 Franchise Today
item.description: Ian Fleming's James Bond is set for a cinematic revival with director Denis Villeneuve's in-the-works feature film, currently known colloquially as Bond 26 . Casting for the new 007 is currently underway, with a half-dozen leading men in contention to succeed actor Daniel Craig, who retired as Bond in 2021's No Time To Die after starring in five franchise films.

item.title: How to get comms modules in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: Getting comms modules in DMZ in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is a pain in the butt, because this epic-tier crafting ingredient is incredibly elusive if you don't know where to look. You need comms modules to unlock uncommon ingredient printing (along with high-tenacity fibers ), to increase your weapon storage, and for other equipment such as fulton drop markers . Once you've unlocked epic ingredient printing you can simply make more, but that's not feasible until you've acquired even rarer ingredients.

item.title: 'Pokémon' Officially Brings Back Long-Lost Rare Monster After 10 Years
item.description: The most elusive Pokémon probably aren't the ones you think. The list of unavailable Pokémon is full of monsters that sound ordinary but, for one reason or another, aren't obtainable. That's why fans are so excited about the new Pokémon Legends: Z-A challenge.
